name: Species Diffusion Slab 20x4
description: 2D quiescent (zero velocity) slab, pure species diffusion of a passive CO2 tracer between fixed left/right concentrations with zero-flux top/bottom -- 20x4 structured Cartesian mesh. P6-PHYS-001: the first production physics.json case to exercise species transport end to end through CaseReader/CaseBuilder/ProjectRunner. Analytical solution: Y(x) = 1 - x/L, independent of y -- see tests/integration/species/test_species_diffusion.cpp for the equation-level validation this case's production wiring is checked against.
